discovery_candidates.description: Advanced todo list app with integrated timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. Integrates with Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Redmine and OpenProject.

install_startup.recipe_modification_note: Super Productivity's own compose recipe builds from source (needing dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org) - used the project's own officially-published Docker Hub image (johannesjo/super-productivity) instead, referenced from its own wiki's 'Run with Docker' page.
